# Core

8 options in this group.

| Key | Default | Summary |
|---|---|---|
| [indent_style](indent_style.md) | `space` | Indent with spaces or tabs. |
| [indent_size](indent_size.md) | `4` | Columns per indent level. |
| [tab_width](tab_width.md) | `4` | Columns a tab occupies when measuring line width. |
| [end_of_line](end_of_line.md) | `auto` | Line ending to write. auto matches whatever the source uses. |
| [insert_final_newline](insert_final_newline.md) | `true` | Ensure the file ends with a newline. |
| [trim_trailing_whitespace](trim_trailing_whitespace.md) | `true` | Remove trailing whitespace from each line. |
| [charset](charset.md) | `preserve` | Byte-order mark handling. preserve keeps whatever the file arrived with. |
| [max_line_length](max_line_length.md) | `off` | Column target for reflow. off disables reflow entirely and selects preservation mode. |
